import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents


class DocumentAccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.addCleanup(self.connection.close)
        initialize(self.connection)
        self.connection.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            [
                (5, "t", "o", "Later", "Later body", None),
                (1, "t", "o", "Title", "Body", None),
                (2, "other", "o", "Other tenant", "Body", None),
                (3, "t", "other", "Other owner", "Body", None),
                (4, "t", "o", "Deleted", "Body", "2026-01-01"),
                (6, "t", "o", "Also deleted", "Body", ""),
                (7, "tenant's", "owner's", "Quoted", "Quoted body", None),
            ],
        )

    def test_unavailable_ids_are_indistinguishable(self):
        for document_id in (2, 3, 4, 6, 99):
            with self.subTest(document_id=document_id):
                self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.connection, "t", "o", document_id))

    def test_visible_results_keep_fields_and_order(self):
        expected = [
            {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
            {"id": 5, "title": "Later", "body": "Later body"},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, "t", "o"), expected)
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.connection, "t", "o", 1), expected[0])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, "missing", "o"), [])

    def test_parameters_are_bound(self):
        expected = {"id": 7, "title": "Quoted", "body": "Quoted body"}
        self.assertEqual(get_document(self.connection, "tenant's", "owner's", 7), expected)
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, "tenant's", "owner's"), [expected])
        for tenant, owner in (("t' OR 1=1 --", "o"), ("t", "o' OR 1=1 --")):
            self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.connection, tenant, owner, 1))
            self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, tenant, owner), [])
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.connection, "t", "o", "1 OR 1=1"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
